biotools.summary: PoseView automatically generates 2D diagrams of protein-ligand complexes, focusing on the interactions between protein and ligand. Interactions between molecules are estimated by an underlying interaction mode that relies on atom types and simple geometric criteria. It adheres to the conventions of chemical structure diagram generation. The quality of the resulting diagrams is comparable to manually drawn examples from books and scientific publications.
